name: @kraftverk/transport-ble
description: Bluetooth LE: the server's radio (noble), the browser's Web Bluetooth and the phone's. Opens the GATT layout a protocol asks for and hands back the bytes; knows no protocol.
//optional: noble is only reached when the server starts Bluetooth, and it is imported
lazily, so a server without it still runs everything else. Optional, so a
container can install with --omit=optional and skip four native builds
(node-gyp, usb, bluetooth-hci-socket, serialport) for a radio it cannot
have anyway. A normal `npm install` still installs it.
